enriched_activities.desc: Lying on bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Left arm under pillow. Right hand on blanket. Legs stretched out. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up to chin. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Occasional deep breath. Body relaxed. No movement. Sleeps through the night.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Put toothbrush down. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk back to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing the day's tasks and preparing for the workday, setting up the desk workspace and turning on the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open notebook. Pick up pen. Write down tasks. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp angle. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for laptop to start. Log in. Open calendar. Check schedule. Arrange papers on desk. Plug in laptop charger. Test keyboard. Open email. Read new messages. Close email. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1, boiling water with the kettle and using the toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Say 'Good morning.' Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Open fridge. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Take out plates. Set table. Take out cups. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into cups. Add tea bags. When toaster pops, take out toast. Put toast on plates. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 1 about the day.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely on arts administration tasks on the computer, coordinating programs and answering emails since the transport strike keeps everyone at home
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Log in. Open email client. Read and reply to emails. Open program coordination software. Update program schedule. Make phone calls. Join video meeting. Take notes. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Adjust monitor. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Stand up and stretch. Walk around room. Sit back down. Continue working. Check phone messages.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch together with Member 1 using the microwave and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open fridge. Take out leftovers. Place leftovers in microwave. Set timer. Press start. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir-fry. When microwave beeps, take out food. Serve on plates. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break resting on the sofa, listening to music and chatting with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Press play. Put phone down. Lean back. Talk with Member 1. Laugh. Adjust cushion. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put magazine down. Check phone. Continue chatting. Stand up. Stretch. Sit back down.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work on the monitor, drawing and revising client artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on monitor. Open illustration software. Open client file. Pick up stylus. Draw lines. Erase lines. Redraw. Adjust colors. Zoom in and out. Save file. Open reference image. Compare. Make revisions. Stand up and stretch. Walk around room. Sit back down. Continue drawing. Check phone. Save final file.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling water with the kettle and having an afternoon tea break
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Take out cup. Put tea bag in cup. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into cup. Add sugar. Stir with spoon. Pick up cup. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Sip tea. Put cup on coaster. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Pick up cup. Sip tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Press power button. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Wrap cord. Put vacuum away. Pick up items from floor. Place items on shelves. Fluff cushions. Fold blanket. Wipe coffee table with cloth. Put cloth away. Adjust TV remote on table. Stand back. Look around room.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add spices. Stir again. Turn off cooker. Serve on plates. Set table. Call Member 1 to dinner. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into bin. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in rack. Pick up glasses. Place in dishwasher. Pick up cutlery. Place in basket. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Put remote down. Lean back. Watch TV. Talk with Member 1. Laugh. Adjust cushion. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Put snack down. Check phone. Continue watching. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put remote down.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing a game on the game console with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up game controller. Turn on console. Select game. Start game. Press buttons. Move controller. Talk with Member 1. Laugh. Pause game. Put controller down. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Pick up controller. Continue game. Save game. Turn off console. Put controller down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching personal illustration projects at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up sketchbook. Open to new page. Pick up pencil. Draw lines. Erase. Redraw. Shade. Pick up eraser. Erase. Pick up pencil. Continue drawing. Turn page. Draw more. Put pencil down. Pick up pencil. Continue drawing. Close sketchbook.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Lather. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Brush teeth. Apply skincare. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Left arm under pillow. Right hand on chest. Legs bent. Straighten legs. Turn head. Sigh. Remain asleep.
